_comment: The update manifest. Both apps read this file and nothing else. Edit it in the browser on github.com when you publish a release — see GITHUB - STEP BY STEP.txt. Keep the version numbers here matching the ones in the builds you upload, or nobody will be told about them.

notes: The dot now asks for a normal conversational level, not just louder than the room
